hypothesis: The locked validation-selective Measure-Orbit portfolio improves proper loss on globally untouched datasets and adds value beyond an exactly update-matched two-seed ordinary-TabM prediction ensemble.
selection_rule: From locally available RTDL-format data, exclude every prior Measure-Orbit dataset, duplicate copies, learning-to-rank tasks, related-source variants of prior datasets, feature width above 500, and class count above 100. Retain every remaining supported source and only the latest date-purged Sberbank window.

pre_outcome_exclusions.south_german_credit: related-source variant of the previously used German credit dataset
pre_outcome_exclusions.aloi: 1000 output classes exceeds the frozen maximum of 100
pre_outcome_exclusions.epsilon: 2000 numerical features exceeds the frozen maximum of 500
pre_outcome_exclusions.sberbank_windows_0_1: dependent windows from the retained Sberbank source
pre_outcome_exclusions.adult_california_covtype_higgs_jannis_mi: duplicate copies of datasets used previously

locked_method.selector: choose baseline_anchor or measure_orbit using lower validation proper loss within each dataset and seed

compute_match.seed_portfolio: the shared baseline_anchor plus an independent ordinary-TabM seedmate
compute_match.matching_rule: Force the seedmate to execute exactly the number of epochs and minibatch updates executed by the measure_orbit fit; retain its best validation checkpoint within that budget.
compute_match.prediction_ensemble: average probabilities for classification and standardized predictions for regression

primary_endpoint: dataset-mean relative test proper-loss reduction of selective Measure-Orbit versus the exactly update-matched two-seed ordinary-TabM prediction ensemble
decision_rule: Validate the external performance claim only if both the primary seed-ensemble gate and the baseline-preservation gate pass. Otherwise retain the 21-dataset confirmation as internal prospective evidence and reject a stronger external-performance claim.
